caption: Savoca hilltown, Savoca
composition: Stone village cascading toward the Ionian coast under grey light · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: The stone village piles up the hill in the center of the frame, a dense jumble of grey houses and terracotta roofs with the church and its bell tower crowning the summit. The Ionian coast curves away to the right, pale sea meeting a grey overcast sky, and wooded slopes fill the lower right. At 08:41 the light is flat and muted under full cloud, giving the old stone a soft, silvery tone.
